overview: FAM4702 is a flight event focused on spin. The notes below are organized off the canonical syllabus items first, then filled out with local FAM gouge so students can brief the event, explain the why behind each item, and stay ahead of instructor follow-up questions.

The AOA approach teaches precise energy and attitude control, using optimum AOA (10-11 units) instead of airspeed for approach guidance. It's a 180° descending turn to final followed by a normal flared landing. This technique is critical for short-field landings and jet/carrier ops.
